description.en: Starts a background load/check of pending data (internally named "Inatter"), used right after NPC replacement and objective updates so anything newly available can be picked up. Poll completion with CMND_INATTER_IS_LOADING, then finalize with CMND_INATTER_CHECK_ADD.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).
